pxd044981.title: Benchmarking DIA data analysis workflows
pxd044981.kind: MaxQuant search results from DDA runs
pxd044981.design: UPS2 protein standard spiked into constant yeast background at five ratios, three replicate DDA runs each; Q Exactive HF.

flashdeconv/scans.parquet.description: One row per MS scan: retention time, MS level, precursor mass and deconvolved mass count.
flashdeconv/scans.parquet.transformation: Renamed to snake_case and downcast; no filtering.

flashdeconv/ms1_map.parquet.description: MS1 retention-time x neutral-mass intensity map, with the scan each point was acquired in.
flashdeconv/ms1_map.parquet.transformation: Renamed and downcast to Float32; joined scan_id on retention time rounded to 2 dp (MS1 scans are ~4 s apart, so the match is unambiguous); sorted by rt.

flashdeconv/deconv_peaks.parquet.description: Deconvolved neutral-mass peaks, one row per peak.
flashdeconv/deconv_peaks.parquet.transformation: Exploded nested list columns into long format and joined scan numbers; assigned a stable peak_id.

pxd044981/proteins.parquet.description: Protein-level differential abundance, ratio10_DDA vs ratio01_DDA (UPS2 spike-in, highest vs lowest level), three replicates each. 23 spike-in proteins against a constant yeast background; 11 proteins significant at padj<0.05 and |log2FC|>1, of which 10 are true spike-ins.
pxd044981/proteins.parquet.transformation: Removed reverse hits and contaminants; summed evidence intensities per (leading razor protein, raw file); log2-transformed and median-normalised each run; Welch t-test across three replicates per group; Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction.

pxd044981/psm_peaks.parquet.description: Singly-charged fragment m/z peaks for 6 spectra of peptide ILNNGHAFNVEFDDSQDK (human carbonic anhydrase 2, UPS2 spike-in P00918), with MaxQuant's matched ion labels.
pxd044981/psm_peaks.parquet.transformation: Split semicolon-separated Masses/Intensities/Matches into one row per peak.

pxd044981/psm_sequences.parquet.description: Peptide sequence, precursor charge and score per spectrum.
